description: Signs this chat in to the person's AINDEX account, so the agent tools work here: their agents, making one, funding it, its checks. Call with no code: it gives a link. The person opens it, signs in with their wallet (a new wallet makes a new account) and presses Allow; the page shows a six-digit code. Ask them for it and call again with code. Nothing in this chat can ever move money out of an agent.

code.description: The six digits the page showed after Allow.

name: connect_account
title: Connect this chat to the person's AINDEX account
